SessionStart._comment: compact is deliberately absent. Codex re-fires SessionStart after compacting, mid-turn, and init clears @ai_agent_running -- which then only comes back on the next UserPromptSubmit that never arrives, so a working pane sits marked idle. Same reason the Claude side matches startup|resume|clear.

PreToolUse._comment: A turn can resume without a UserPromptSubmit -- after a compaction, or when a queued message is picked up -- and nothing else would mark the pane running again. Every such continuation reaches a tool call. Guarded by a single tmux read so the common already-running case costs nothing.
